# Check to OWASP Agentic Top 10 mapping (taxonomy v0.1)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_taxonomy_docs.py from taxonomy/asi-mapping.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which **AiEnsured agentest, an Agentic AI Testing platform** check guards against which entry of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (ASI01 to ASI10). The machine-readable source is [`taxonomy/asi-mapping.yaml`](../../taxonomy/asi-mapping.yaml). The failure categories the checks are grouped into are in the [taxonomy](TAXONOMY.md).

**Read this first.** This is an informal crosswalk for orientation. It is not a compliance claim, an audit result or a certification statement, and a passing run does not make a system safe against an ASI entry. The ASI IDs and titles are quoted from the OWASP document below (CC BY-SA 4.0). The assignment of checks to them is this project's own judgement, OWASP has not reviewed or endorsed it, and corrections are welcome by pull request.

## Source

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026 (OWASP GenAI Security Project, Agentic Security Initiative), version 2026, December 2025.
- Page: <https://genai.owasp.org/resource/owasp-top-10-for-agentic-applications-for-2026/>
- Document: <https://genai.owasp.org/download/52117/>
- Fetched: 2026-11-26. If OWASP revises the list, this mapping is revisited and the taxonomy version is bumped.

## How a check is mapped

- **direct**: A failing run is an instance of what the ASI entry describes (its description or one of its common examples).
- **partial**: The check guards a control or precondition the ASI entry names, or covers part of it, without being an instance of the entry itself.
- **no ASI mapping**: the check does not fit any entry, so it is left unmapped with a reason. Nothing is forced into an entry to raise the count.

A secondary [NIST AI RMF](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) function tag (GOVERN, MANAGE or MEASURE) is given per failure category where one is clear. Function tags (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE) are indicative and assigned per failure category; absent where no function is clear. Not a compliance claim.

## Coverage

All 221 registered checks were assessed: the 165 core tests, 15 opt-in New tests (outside the 165) and 41 checks in the opt-in extension packs. 122 have at least one ASI entry and 99 have no ASI mapping.

| Set | Checks | Mapped to an ASI entry | No ASI mapping |
|---|---|---|---|
| core (165 tests) | 165 | 90 | 75 |
| opt-in New test | 15 | 5 | 10 |
| extension pack | 41 | 27 | 14 |
| all | 221 | 122 | 99 |

Checks per ASI entry (a check can map to more than one):

| ASI | Title | Direct | Partial | Checks | of which core | of which opt-in or pack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ASI01 | Agent Goal Hijack | 20 | 5 | 25 | 20 | 5 |
| ASI02 | Tool Misuse and Exploitation | 20 | 22 | 42 | 36 | 6 |
| ASI03 | Identity and Privilege Abuse | 21 | 10 | 31 | 23 | 8 |
| ASI04 | Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities | 2 | 1 | 3 | 0 | 3 |
| ASI05 | Unexpected Code Execution (RCE) | 0 | 5 | 5 | 3 | 2 |
| ASI06 | Memory & Context Poisoning | 1 | 5 | 6 | 4 | 2 |
| ASI07 | Insecure Inter-Agent Communication | 3 | 6 | 9 | 5 | 4 |
| ASI08 | Cascading Failures | 3 | 6 | 9 | 0 | 9 |
| ASI09 | Human-Agent Trust Exploitation | 3 | 22 | 25 | 22 | 3 |
| ASI10 | Rogue Agents | 1 | 6 | 7 | 3 | 4 |

Entries with no direct check: ASI05 (Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)). These are coverage gaps in agentest, not a statement that the risk is absent. [Contributions are welcome](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#add-a-check-or-a-test-case).
